title: Handle is a little loose
text: Handle is a little loose. In general, this is a decent and functional egg whisk, but it is not as solid as other utensils I have gotten from Kung Fu.  I have really liked their silicone products and was a little let down with how much wiggle there is in this handle.  It works, but not up to their other products.
